name: zebra-mod
description: Turns Claude Code into a rare-disease research workstation: phenotype-driven diagnosis, variant interpretation (ACMG), sequence-to-function models, genotype-to-therapy, classical statistics — every answer anchored to live public databases.

python.title: Python
python.description: Python 3.9+ interpreter that runs the zebra CLI (standard library only)

doctrine.title: Research doctrine
doctrine.description: Rare-disease research rules in the system prompt. auto: the full rules while a case is open, otherwise a short section that applies only to rare-disease questions (other work is untouched). always: the full rules in every session. case: only while a case is open. off: never.

privacyGate.title: Privacy gate
privacyGate.description: Refuse outgoing calls that carry the open case's protected identifiers or ID/phone/email patterns, and ask before files from the case folder or raw genome data leave the machine. With no case open, a pattern in another tool's call is asked about rather than refused.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: How much zebra-mod shows in Claude Code. full: its own rows for its tool calls, the databases being queried in the spinner, a galloping zebra above the prompt while it queries, a shield after the privacy gate refuses a call, a footer label and a one-line summary at the end of a turn. quiet: the same without the animation and the spinner text. off: Claude Code's own drawing only.
